messages:
devon: Heads-up: planning a small runtime rollout tonight at 22:00 PDT (approx 02:00 UTC) — applies to two micro-batches on gpu-pool-b. Targets: kernel v2.14.3 + quant profile 'p95-trim'. Will be a staggered 10-minute slot per slice. Who can own smoke/rollback?

sasha: I can own smoke for the 22:00->22:30 window. Will run the perf + correctness checks.

maria: I'll be available for rollback; tag me if the perf regression >5% or error-rate >0.5%.

lin: Can someone post the quick smoke commands? need to add to my calendar.

ops-bot: Deploy window registered: 2025-02-15T22:00:00Z -> 2025-02-15T22:40:00Z. Alerting: #eng-oncall and PagerDuty.

devon: Thanks. Smoke checklist (short):
1) run smoke load: `scripts/smoke/run.sh --profile p95-trim --concurrency 4 --seq 512`
2) check tail errors: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod | grep -E "(ERROR|panic)"`
3) run quality prompts: `./ci/evals/quick_eval.sh --model kernel:v2.14.3`
If everything green, mark :white_check_mark: in this thread.

kyle: I'll watch traces and metrics. Quick thresholds:
- p50 latency increase >10% -> fail
- p95 latency increase >12% -> fail
- token cost drop is expected; watch quality

sasha: Doing a dry run now on staging. ping if you want to watch: https://dash.internal/redwood/staging/runtime

maria: One more note: KV cache warmup may affect first-min latency; ignore first 2 minutes of samples.

devon: @sasha when you finish staging, paste the staging perf numbers here (p50/p95/error-rate/cost).

sasha: Staging results: p50 18ms -> 19ms (+5.5%), p95 120ms -> 128ms (+6.7%), error-rate 0.03% -> 0.04%, cost -3.2%.
Looks OK. I'll still run the quality prompts.

lin: calendar booked. Who's the fallback model? If rollback triggers, do we pin to kernel:v2.14.2 or model-quant:stable?

devon: Fallback: kernel:v2.14.2 + quant profile 'stable' (ops playbook section 3.2). Rollback steps:
- update service config to image:v2.14.2
- restart pods on pool
- monitor for 10 min
- if still bad, escalate to infra SRE.

kyle: I'll prepare a quick rollback script and post link.

kyle: `/deploy rollback --service runtime --image kernel:v2.14.2 --pool gpu-pool-b` -> should be single command for the window. I pushed the helper to https://git.internal/redwood/ops/rollback-scripts

maria: Also capture a trace sample and save with tag `rollout-1759999999` for later analysis.

devon: Perfect. Owner matrix:
- smoke: sasha
- rollback exec: kyle
- escalation: maria
- deploy trigger: devon
I'll start the deploy 22:00 PDT. If anyone can't make it, call out now.

sasha: :thumbsup: I'll be online in channel ~10m before start.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 15m before deploy (21:45 PDT) to #eng-runtime and oncall.

lin: One tiny ask: add `--kv-warmup=false` to the canary so we can isolate behavior. devon ok?

devon: Good idea. We'll set kv_warmup=false for the first slice and enable on second. Noted.

sasha: After canary, I'll run same quality prompt set and paste results.

maria: If rollback happens, please include the trace + metrics in the incident doc template (link in ops runbook).

devon: Thanks team. I'll post final 'go/no-go' 10m before window.
